Magnhild,
Attached, eleven pages. The summary, since eleven pages is a great deal to ask of anyone.
The teaching collection is 31,400 catalogued objects. The environmental requirement is 45 to 55 percent relative humidity held continuously, not seasonally, with a permitted excursion of no more than 5 percent over 24 hours. That figure is not mine.
